card.name: Punctuation after co-prescribing opioid warning
card.fires_on: The comma ending the clause "If the decision is made to prescribe a benzodiazepine ... concomitantly with an opioid", just before "prescribe the lowest effective dosages". Also the colon after PRECAUTIONS in cross-references.

modes.label: Comma after opioid co-prescribing clause
modes.description: Comma closing the if-clause about prescribing a sedative together with opioids.
modes.example: If the decision is made to prescribe a benzodiazepine or other CNS depressant concomitantly with an opioid analgesic<<,>> prescribe the lowest effective dosages and minimum

modes.label: Colon after PRECAUTIONS
modes.description: Colon in a see-section cross-reference, before a subsection title.

card.plain: It marks the punctuation where a label's opioid co-prescribing warning turns to its instruction, and where a cross-reference names a subsection.
